items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You said Frank Cuny was with him. ... INTERVIEWEE: No.

ctx.x: He didn't know he had a brother that played trumpet, a good trumpet boy. I had forgotten his name. Frank. Frank, yeah. See, he knows them all. Let's stop a second and see if he's recording all right.
Yeah, let's see. I wanted to ask you some more if we can get back. Who was your first teacher?
